# Standalone JT repository

Source: `nj22az/nj22az.github.io`, commit
`49c5d845128c49f73dd81b07778ad5c6f2a990fc`, copied on 28 September 2026.

Johansson Town is at the repository root. Thuan’s Storage is included in
`thuans-storage/`; the town links into it and its return button goes to `../`.
The creator remains at `creator/`. Existing localStorage keys are preserved.
The intended public address is `https://nj22az.github.io/JT/`.

## Publishing

Select **GitHub Actions** in this repository’s **Settings → Pages**. The
`Publish Johansson Town` workflow builds and checks every push to `main`,
then publishes `_site/`. It can also be started manually. Pull requests run
the build and checks without publishing.

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm run build:pages
npm run check:pages
node --test tests/runtime-package.test.mjs
node --test --test-name-pattern='old saved visits' tests/consolidation.test.mjs
npm run test:storage
```

The Pages build includes the raw modules required by the creator, static assets,
and the current eight runtime bundles. Historical bundles from the old address
are omitted from the initial import; later local runtime builds still retain
older hashes for cached pages. Authoring files, dependencies and tests are not
included in the deployed artifact. Licences and attribution records are retained.

Form 3D Studio and StepWise are separate applications still served at their
existing account-root URLs. Regenerating workshop model JSON needs the sibling
`form-3d-studio` authoring checkout, as before. It is not needed to build or run JT.

## Validation and existing limitations

The deployment checker resolves HTML, CSS and module references beneath a
`/JT/` prefix, checks the manifest scope and entry points, and checks the rebuilt
stockroom’s return link and character path. It found 837 local references.
The three compiled-runtime checks, the existing saved-visit migration check,
and all six stockroom checks pass.

The imported broad game suite is not a clean release gate. A full-suite attempt
failed; isolated checks confirmed that the boot test’s FPV-only expectation and
three consolidation assertions also fail unchanged in the source repository
at the commit above (doorstep position and missing worker fixtures). Those game
behaviour tests are retained for follow-up and are not claimed to pass here.
The deployment workflow uses the focused migration checks listed above.

This move does not constitute a new rendered game, physical touchscreen or
performance acceptance pass. The old published town and its repository are
unchanged, providing a fallback during the transition.

# Thuan's Storage

Work in progress.

Walk Thuan through Sakura Shōten's changing stockroom, collect six marked goods,
and return to the pink shop curtain. Receiving and dispatch bays connect to four
stock departments with random shelf banks and clear cross-aisles.

- WASD / arrows: walk. Shift: run. Drag: look. Escape: pause.
- Touch: Move and Look pads, with a held Run button.
- Gamepad: left stick moves, right stick looks; shoulder / stick press runs.
- “Let Thuan restock” follows a real route, collects the list and returns to the
  shop. Move or select “Take control” to take over. Assisted runs do not set a best time.
- “New list” changes the layout. “Same stockroom” retains the current seed.

The original Thuan model supplies walking, running, greeting, breathing and
celebration clips. Pickup reactions add a nod and a brief hand movement. An
animated stand-in keeps the game playable while the model loads.

### Source and verification

The original export contained only a compiled bundle. Its unchanged dependency
code is preserved in `vendor/original-runtime.js`; the editable game sections are
under `src/`. No dependency installation is required:

```sh
node thuans-storage/scripts/build-runtime.mjs
node --test thuans-storage/tests/playability.test.mjs
```

The build produces a content-hashed runtime and updates `index.html`. Commit both
the source and generated output. GitHub Pages serves the committed files directly.

Tests cover 300 seeded layouts, collision sliding, keyboard and touch input reset,
the actual GLB skeleton and animation weights, pause/resume, and four complete
automatic restocking runs. Numerical tests use the real Three.js scene and skin;
they substitute the GPU renderer and sound. They do not verify visual rendering
or performance on a physical phone.

Play it at [nj22az.github.io/JT/thuans-storage](https://nj22az.github.io/JT/thuans-storage/).
